mathematical_review.method: Main author checked sources and reuse; independent read-only review checked all harmonic-rigidity notes and selected high-risk contact statements and proofs. Corrections were applied before the final build.
corrected: CAT(0) projection explicitly requires a nonempty closed geodesically convex set.
Local first variation uses relatively compact domains, allowing infinite global energy.
Model zero-tension equations explicitly characterize harmonic maps.
Building-valued pluriharmonicity requires local Lipschitz regularity and harmonicity after every holomorphic disk map, including disks through singularities.
Short distance-minimizing connection geodesics are restricted to the Levi-Civita connection.
Riemannian cell complexes have a concrete polyhedral definition; incorrect cup-product and convex-cocompact-group links were replaced.
Zariski density is expressed after base change to an algebraic closure of the local field.
The punctured-disk energy proof now links the precise pullback-tensor and polar-energy theorem.
Volume and Fatou prerequisites point to atomic definitions/results rather than navigation or generic integration pages.
Stabilization formulas retain coorientation, null-homology and the transported Seifert surface.
The integral Chern obstruction uses the cited normal Euler-class theorem, not an isolated-zero count that would miss torsion.
The polygon grading and action-area signs were checked against Etnyre section 4.1; no unverified grading shift was added.
mathematical_review.boundary: Selected elementary proofs and deductions are written out. Building regularity, superrigidity, holomorphic rigidity, contact classification and embedding results retain precise external inputs. The two packet files list deferred branches and proofs; this is not a complete internal reconstruction of either research chapter.

source_checks.scanner_boundary: Term scanning retains candidates for human reading. They are not automatically treated as missing prerequisites.

browser_checks.visual_review: Both topic outlines inspected in desktop and mobile screenshots; title wrapping, paragraph spacing and links retain the reading theme.

publication: Local build and preview only; no commit, push or GitHub Pages deployment requested in this turn.
